bg.title: Оценка на зрелостта на облака и платформата
bg.intro: 21 въпроса в 10 области: от landing zones и идентичност до устойчивост и FinOps. Резултатът показва зрелост по области, рискове, бързи подобрения, целево състояние и пътна карта за 30/60/90 дни.
bg.disclaimer: Самооценка по вашите отговори. Нямаме достъп до вашите облачни среди и не правим сканиране. Резултатът не е сертификат за съответствие и не е проверен от независима страна.

platform_ops.description: Как се управляват Kubernetes, контейнери, виртуални машини и serverless.

cicd.title: CI/CD и управление на внедряванията

security_policy.description: Видимост на сигурността и политики, наложени автоматично.

options.sso: Централен доставчик на идентичност (SSO) за всички
options.sso_mfa_jit: SSO с MFA и временен повишен достъп

options.admin_broad: Широки администраторски права са честа практика
options.least_privilege: Минимални права, редовни прегледи, без дълготрайни ключове

options.controlled: Сегментирана, с централен контрол на входящ и изходящ трафик и частни крайни точки

options.ad_hoc: При нужда (VPN или peering се създават ръчно)

initial.title: Начално
initial.description: Повечето практики са ръчни или липсват; рискът зависи от отделни хора.

developing.title: В развитие
developing.description: Има основни практики, но не навсякъде и не по еднакъв начин.

defined.title: Дефинирано
defined.description: Практиките са стандартизирани и повечето се прилагат автоматично.

optimised.title: Оптимизирано
optimised.description: Практиките са автоматизирани, измервани и непрекъснато подобрявани.

risk_shared_account.title: Всичко в един общ акаунт
risk_shared_account.description: Продукция, тестове и експерименти споделят граници, права и лимити. Една грешка или пробив засяга всичко.

risk_identity.title: Неуправлявани идентичности и широки права
risk_identity.description: Локални потребители, споделени пароли или широки администраторски права са най-честият път към пробив в облака.

risk_flat_network.title: Плоска мрежа
risk_flat_network.description: Без сегментация един компрометиран ресурс може да достигне всичко останало.

risk_manual_infra.title: Ръчна инфраструктура
risk_manual_infra.description: Средите не могат да се възпроизведат, промените не се преглеждат и отклоненията остават незабелязани.

risk_uncontrolled_deploys.title: Неконтролирани внедрявания
risk_uncontrolled_deploys.description: Без pipeline и одитна следа е трудно да разберете какво е променено, от кого и как да го върнете.

risk_blind_operations.title: Работа на сляпо
risk_blind_operations.description: Проблемите се откриват от клиентите, а не от мониторинга.

risk_no_recovery.title: Няма надежден път за възстановяване
risk_no_recovery.description: Без редовни резервни копия или план за възстановяване загубата на данни или регион може да е необратима.

risk_unknown_posture.title: Неизвестно състояние на сигурността
risk_unknown_posture.description: Публично отворени ресурси и грешни настройки остават незабелязани, докато някой не ги използва.

qw_sso_mfa.title: SSO и MFA за всеки достъп до конзолата
qw_sso_mfa.description: Свържете конзолите с вашия доставчик на идентичност, наложете MFA и закрийте локалните потребители.

qw_restore_test.title: Тест за възстановяване на една критична система
qw_restore_test.description: Възстановете една критична база данни в отделна среда и запишете колко време отне.

qw_tagging_budgets.title: Етикети, бюджети и известия за разходите
qw_tagging_budgets.description: Задайте задължителни етикети (екип, среда, продукт) и бюджети с известия.

qw_key_alerts.title: Известия за няколкото сигнала, които имат значение
qw_key_alerts.description: Започнете с наличност, грешки и латентност на основните услуги, с ясен получател на известията.

qw_iac_pipeline.title: Прилагане на инфраструктурата през pipeline
qw_iac_pipeline.description: Преместете plan и apply в pipeline с преглед, така че всяка промяна да има запис.

qw_posture_baseline.title: Вградената проверка на сигурността на доставчика
qw_posture_baseline.description: Включете вградения инструмент на вашия доставчик за проверка на състоянието и прегледайте най-сериозните находки.

rec_landing_zone.title: Landing zone с ясна структура
rec_landing_zone.description: Разделете продукция и непродукция, въведете процес за нови акаунти и общи предпазни правила.

rec_identity.title: Централна идентичност и минимални права
rec_identity.description: Роли по задачи, редовни прегледи на достъпа и временен повишен достъп вместо постоянни администратори.

rec_network.title: Сегментирана мрежа със стандартна топология
rec_network.description: Сегменти по среди и натоварвания, централен контрол на изходящия трафик и топология, описана като код.

rec_iac.title: Инфраструктура като код за основните компоненти
rec_iac.description: Модули за мрежа, идентичност и изчисления, прилагани през pipeline с преглед.

rec_platform.title: Управлявани платформи и автоматични обновявания
rec_platform.description: Предпочетете управлявани услуги, базови конфигурации и автоматично обновяване на образите.

rec_cicd.title: Pipeline с одобрения и одитна следа
rec_cicd.description: Всяко внедряване през pipeline, с одобрение за продукция и запис кой какво е пуснал.

rec_observability.title: Централна наблюдаемост и дежурства
rec_observability.description: Централни логове и метрики, известия към дежурен и инструкции за най-честите инциденти.

rec_resilience.title: Определени RTO/RPO и тествано възстановяване
rec_resilience.description: Определете колко данни и време може да загубите, архивирайте извън основния акаунт и тествайте.

rec_security.title: Видимост на сигурността и първи политики като код
rec_security.description: Непрекъсната проверка на състоянието и няколко наложени политики (криптиране, публичен достъп, регион).

rec_finops.title: Разпределение на разходите и редовна оптимизация
rec_finops.description: Разходи по екип и продукт, месечен преглед и преоразмеряване на най-големите позиции.

ts_platform.title: Вътрешна платформа със „златни пътища“
ts_platform.description: Шаблони за нови услуги с вградени мрежа, идентичност, наблюдаемост и pipeline, достъпни на самообслужване.

ts_policy_as_code.title: Политики като код от pipeline до работеща среда
ts_policy_as_code.description: Едни и същи правила се проверяват при промяна и непрекъснато, а изключенията се записват и изтичат.

ts_slo.title: SLO за ключовите услуги
ts_slo.description: Цели за надеждност, договорени с бизнеса, и известия по изразходвания бюджет за грешки.

ts_dr_automation.title: Автоматизирано и редовно тествано възстановяване
ts_dr_automation.description: Възстановяване, описано като код и тествано по график, с измерени RTO и RPO.

ts_unit_economics.title: Разход на единица и автоматична оптимизация
ts_unit_economics.description: Разход на поръчка, клиент или заявка и автоматични графици и мащабиране.

ctx_multi_cloud.title: Няколко облака не са еквивалентни
ctx_multi_cloud.description: AWS акаунтите, Azure абонаментите и GCP проектите имат различни граници, модели на права и мрежи. Препоръките трябва да се приложат поотделно за всеки доставчик, не чрез обща абстракция.

ctx_aws.title: AWS: термини
ctx_aws.description: В AWS структурата е AWS Organizations с акаунти и SCP политики; входът обикновено е през IAM Identity Center.

ctx_azure.title: Azure: термини
ctx_azure.description: В Azure структурата е management groups и абонаменти с Azure Policy; идентичността е в Microsoft Entra ID.

ctx_gcp.title: Google Cloud: термини
ctx_gcp.description: В Google Cloud структурата е организация, папки и проекти с Organization Policy; правата са в IAM на ниво ресурс.

ctx_hybrid_private.title: Хибридни и частни среди
ctx_hybrid_private.description: В собствени центрове и частни облаци много от управляваните услуги липсват: архивирането, обновяванията и мрежата изискват собствени процеси и хора.

en.title: Cloud & Platform Maturity Assessment
en.intro: 21 questions across 10 areas, from landing zones and identity to resilience and FinOps. The result shows maturity per area, risks, quick wins, a target state and a 30/60/90-day roadmap.
en.disclaimer: A self-assessment based on your answers. We have no access to your cloud environments and perform no scanning. The result is not a compliance certification and has not been independently verified.

landing_zones.title: Landing zones and organisation
landing_zones.description: How accounts, subscriptions or projects are organised, and the organisation-wide guardrails.

identity.title: Identity and least privilege
identity.description: Central sign-in, MFA and permissions limited to what is needed.

network.title: Network segmentation and connectivity
network.description: Network separation and how connections between environments, sites and clouds are managed.

iac.title: Infrastructure as Code
iac.description: How much infrastructure is defined as code and how changes are applied.

platform_ops.title: Container and compute platform operations
platform_ops.description: How Kubernetes, containers, virtual machines and serverless are operated.

cicd.title: CI/CD and deployment governance
cicd.description: How changes reach production and who approves them.

observability.title: Observability and incident readiness
observability.description: Monitoring, alerting and how incidents are handled.

resilience.title: Backup, recovery and resilience
resilience.description: Backups, restore tests and disaster recovery.

security_policy.title: Security posture and policy automation
security_policy.description: Visibility of the security posture and automatically enforced policies.

finops.title: FinOps and capacity management
finops.description: Cost visibility, allocation and capacity optimisation.

cloud_context.help: Select all that apply. Used only for notes on the result; it does not change the score.

options.on_premises: Own servers without a cloud platform

lz_structure.text: How are cloud accounts, subscriptions or projects organised?

options.single_shared: One shared account or subscription for everything
options.landing_zone: A governed landing zone with a process for creating new ones

lz_guardrails.help: For example, policies at the organisation, management group or folder level.

id_sso.text: How do people sign in to the cloud consoles?

options.local_users: Individual local users or shared passwords
options.sso: A central identity provider (SSO) for everyone
options.sso_mfa_jit: SSO with MFA and time-limited elevated access

options.least_privilege: Least privilege, regular reviews, no long-lived keys

options.controlled: Segmented, with central ingress/egress control and private endpoints

net_connectivity.text: How is connectivity between environments, sites and clouds managed?

options.ad_hoc: As needed (VPNs or peerings created by hand)
options.as_code: A standard topology managed as code

iac_coverage.text: How much of the infrastructure is defined as code?

options.none: Mostly created by hand in the consoles
options.all: Practically all; manual changes are exceptions

options.pipeline: Through a pipeline with plan review
options.pipeline_policy: Through a pipeline with review, policy checks and drift detection

platform_ops.text: How are your runtime platforms (virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes, serverless) operated?

options.partial: Partly automated; upgrades happen when needed
options.managed: Managed services, automated upgrades and baselines
options.platform: An internal platform with templates, policies and self-service

platform_patching.text: How are images and runtimes patched?

options.manual: By hand, when there is time
options.immutable: Immutable images rebuilt and rolled out automatically

options.progressive: Through a pipeline with automated tests, approval and progressive rollout

cicd_governance.text: Who can deploy to production and how is it recorded?

options.approved: Approved changes and an audit trail
options.policy: Enforced approvals, separation of duties and a full audit trail

options.slo: Logs, metrics, traces and SLO-based alerts

options.contacts: There are named people, no runbooks
options.practiced: On-call, runbooks, post-incident reviews and drills

options.tested: Automatic, isolated or immutable, with regular restore tests

bk_dr.text: Do you have a disaster recovery plan?

options.tested: Tested occasionally, with defined RTO and RPO
options.automated: Tested regularly, largely automated, multi-zone or multi-region by design

sec_posture.text: How do you track your security posture?

options.tooling: Posture management tooling, findings are tracked

options.some: Policy as code for some controls
options.broad: Policy as code in pipelines and at runtime, with recorded exceptions

fin_visibility.text: What visibility do you have of cloud costs?

options.allocated: Costs allocated to teams or products
options.unit: Allocated, with budgets, alerts and unit costs

fin_capacity.text: How are capacity and optimisation managed?

options.regular: Regular rightsizing and review of commitments
options.automated: Automated scaling, scheduling and continuous optimisation

initial.title: Initial
initial.description: Most practices are manual or missing; risk depends on individual people.

developing.title: Developing
developing.description: Basic practices exist, but not everywhere and not consistently.

defined.title: Defined
defined.description: Practices are standardised and most are applied automatically.

optimised.title: Optimised
optimised.description: Practices are automated, measured and continuously improved.

risk_shared_account.title: Everything in one shared account
risk_shared_account.description: Production, tests and experiments share boundaries, permissions and limits. One mistake or breach affects everything.

risk_identity.title: Unmanaged identities and broad privileges
risk_identity.description: Local users, shared passwords or broad administrator rights are the most common path to a cloud breach.

risk_flat_network.title: Flat network
risk_flat_network.description: Without segmentation, one compromised resource can reach everything else.

risk_manual_infra.title: Manual infrastructure
risk_manual_infra.description: Environments cannot be reproduced, changes are not reviewed and drift goes unnoticed.

risk_uncontrolled_deploys.title: Uncontrolled deployments
risk_uncontrolled_deploys.description: Without a pipeline and an audit trail it is hard to know what changed, who changed it and how to roll it back.

risk_blind_operations.title: Operating blind
risk_blind_operations.description: Problems are found by customers, not by monitoring.

risk_no_recovery.title: No reliable path to recovery
risk_no_recovery.description: Without regular backups or a recovery plan, losing data or a region may be irreversible.

risk_unknown_posture.title: Unknown security posture
risk_unknown_posture.description: Publicly exposed resources and misconfigurations go unnoticed until someone exploits them.

qw_sso_mfa.title: SSO and MFA for all console access
qw_sso_mfa.description: Connect the consoles to your identity provider, enforce MFA and close local users.

qw_restore_test.title: A restore test of one critical system
qw_restore_test.description: Restore one critical database into a separate environment and record how long it took.

qw_tagging_budgets.title: Tags, budgets and cost alerts
qw_tagging_budgets.description: Make a few tags mandatory (team, environment, product) and set budgets with alerts.

qw_key_alerts.title: Alerts for the few signals that matter
qw_key_alerts.description: Start with availability, errors and latency of the main services, each with a clear recipient.

qw_iac_pipeline.title: Apply infrastructure through a pipeline
qw_iac_pipeline.description: Move plan and apply into a reviewed pipeline so every change is recorded.

qw_posture_baseline.title: Your provider's built-in posture checks
qw_posture_baseline.description: Turn on your provider's native posture tool and review the most severe findings.

rec_landing_zone.title: A landing zone with a clear structure
rec_landing_zone.description: Separate production and non-production, introduce a process for new accounts and shared guardrails.

rec_identity.title: Central identity and least privilege
rec_identity.description: Task-based roles, regular access reviews and time-limited elevation instead of permanent administrators.

rec_network.title: A segmented network with a standard topology
rec_network.description: Segments per environment and workload, central egress control and a topology defined as code.

rec_iac.title: Infrastructure as Code for the core components
rec_iac.description: Modules for network, identity and compute, applied through a reviewed pipeline.

rec_platform.title: Managed platforms and automated patching
rec_platform.description: Prefer managed services, baseline configurations and automated image updates.

rec_cicd.title: A pipeline with approvals and an audit trail
rec_cicd.description: Every deployment through a pipeline, with approval for production and a record of who released what.

rec_observability.title: Central observability and on-call
rec_observability.description: Central logs and metrics, alerts routed to an on-call person and runbooks for the most common incidents.

rec_resilience.title: Defined RTO/RPO and tested recovery
rec_resilience.description: Define how much data and time you can lose, back up outside the main account and test it.

rec_security.title: Posture visibility and first policies as code
rec_security.description: Continuous posture checks and a few enforced policies (encryption, public access, region).

rec_finops.title: Cost allocation and regular optimisation
rec_finops.description: Costs per team and product, a monthly review and rightsizing of the largest items.

ts_platform.title: An internal platform with golden paths
ts_platform.description: Templates for new services with network, identity, observability and pipeline built in, available as self-service.

ts_policy_as_code.title: Policy as code from pipeline to runtime
ts_policy_as_code.description: The same rules are checked at change time and continuously; exceptions are recorded and expire.

ts_slo.title: SLOs for the key services
ts_slo.description: Reliability targets agreed with the business and alerts on error-budget burn.

ts_dr_automation.title: Automated, regularly tested recovery
ts_dr_automation.description: Recovery defined as code and tested on a schedule, with measured RTO and RPO.

ts_unit_economics.title: Unit costs and automated optimisation
ts_unit_economics.description: Cost per order, customer or request, with automated schedules and scaling.

ctx_multi_cloud.title: Several clouds are not equivalent
ctx_multi_cloud.description: AWS accounts, Azure subscriptions and GCP projects have different boundaries, permission models and networking. Apply the recommendations per provider, not through one common abstraction.

ctx_aws.title: AWS: terms
ctx_aws.description: In AWS the structure is AWS Organizations with accounts and SCPs; sign-in usually goes through IAM Identity Center.

ctx_azure.title: Azure: terms
ctx_azure.description: In Azure the structure is management groups and subscriptions with Azure Policy; identity lives in Microsoft Entra ID.

ctx_gcp.title: Google Cloud: terms
ctx_gcp.description: In Google Cloud the structure is an organisation, folders and projects with Organization Policy; permissions are IAM bindings on resources.

ctx_hybrid_private.title: Hybrid and private environments
ctx_hybrid_private.description: In own data centres and private clouds many managed services are missing: backups, patching and networking need your own processes and people.
